newsitem.title: CHINA: China machine-building sector seen reviving.
newsitem.headline: China machine-building sector seen reviving.

text.p: China's machine-building industry, after struggling over the last two years, has shown signs of reviving in the first half of this year, state media said on Wednesday.

The industry posted total output of 247.9 billion yuan ($29.86 billion) in the first half for a year-on-year rise of 9.6 percent while sales were 236.6 billion yuan, up 6.8 percent, the official China Daily said.
Profits, however, were still sluggish at 4.35 billion yuan, compared with 4.37 billion yuan in the same period last year, state media said.
Falling demand for new investment projects, increasing competition from imports and tight credit have resulted in losses for about half of the sector's enterprises, said the China Daily.

Export earning rose 6.8 percent to 15.36 billion yuan and the ratio of production to sales improved to 95.5 percent from 91.8 percent over the same period, the newspaper said, quoting the Ministry of Machine-Building Industry.
Sales of motor vehicles, agricultural machinery, instruments and gauges, as well as petrochemical and electrical equipment, led the recovery, the newspaper said.
China's machine-building industry is predicted to generate 510 billion yuan in industrial output value this year, an increase of 10 percent from last year, state media said.
